description: ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.9 TestSpecification criterion (B2MML TestSpecificationCriteria): one controlled characteristic of a test specification — on a drawing the ballooned feature with its tolerance — and the property it evaluates.

properties.name: criterion_id
properties.description: Identity of the criterion as the source names it (e.g. the balloon number of the characteristic on the drawing revision).

properties.name: description
properties.description: What the characteristic is, as the source says it.

properties.name: sequence
properties.description: The order of the criterion within its specification.

properties.name: expression
properties.description: The tolerance as the specification states it (e.g. 12.00 ±0.05).

properties.name: evaluated_property
properties.description: The property this criterion evaluates — the parameter (param_name) of the product definition whose band it sets.

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: it names a property, not an object.

properties.name: test_specification_ref
properties.description: The test specification (in its revision) this criterion belongs to.

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: B2MML nests the criteria inside their specification; a criterion is no object of the ISA-95 edge catalogue, so the link lives in the key, not in an edge.

isa95.note: B2MML 0701 TestSpecificationCriteria: a criterion of a test specification with its expression and the evaluated property; the characteristic of a drawing (PLM) is such a criterion, its revision the Version of its specification.
isa95.mappingNote: B2MML carries the specification of a criterion through the nesting of TestSpecificationCriteria, not as a field; a criterion is no object of the ISA-95 edge catalogue, so test_specification_ref is a value, not an edge.
isa95.grain: one criterion of one test specification (ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.9): one row = one characteristic of a specification revision, keyed by criterion_id; the specification itself is SMProfile-TestSpecification
